== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The May and June control-phase penalty counts controlled battleground asteroid sectors. The later text counts namesake Asteroid Field cards. Decipher identifies both Big One and Asteroid Field as asteroid sectors; Presence Of The Force can give a controlled Big One the two active icon sides needed for battleground status. The three-loss limit, Rycar’s Run, asteroid-sector deployment choices, Asteroid Sanctuary cancellation and Alter immunity remain.
